title: A thing without ZENTRALE, documented in Schematix (major 1)
description: One file per thing in data/schematix/things/<id>.json (synced): a router, switch, cable, power bank, charger … — real but outside software (state documented, memory/hub/building_kit_plan.md 6.3). Its piece on the map is device:<id> with the address zentrale://schematix/things/<id>/; its kind gives its ports (contracts/schematix/1/kinds.json). `links` are its physical and network connections (wires of the link-scoped port types, owned by the thing). Readers keep fields they do not know (core/formats.py).
